title: Toledo — Equation Library of the Human–AI Readout Programme
description: The permanent, coded registry of every equation in the Human–AI Readout Programme together with its Coq (Th_coqc) formalisation. Th_coqc certifies that a lemma is closed under a stated finite model's global context — an internal-consistency check, never an empirical or physical truth claim. v1.7 registers 1,273 entries (610 root rows). Four additions: (1) six Equation River readings (weld/M.33.v1 rung set, weld/M.34.v1 strengthening law, weld/M.35.v1 strength readout as a held set rather than a scalar, EQ-015/H.50.v1 return map, weld/M.36.v1 stage non-collapse, EQ-015/M.17.v1 stages 3–4 on Q); (2) the 274 `information-discrete-math` root-extension readings introduced at v1.6 as `mapped_not_wrapped` now wrapped in Toledo-native Coq files and verified closed (coq_status `closed` 277 → 551, `mapped_not_wrapped` 274 → 0); (3) presentation MathML extended from 447 to 863 canonical-entry (reading) rows, with 16 real conversion failures disclosed per-entry in `mathml_error` rather than silently dropped — root rows remain ascii-only, documented as open work; (4) an opt-in Executable Equations pilot layer v0.1 (one intermediate-representation file per equation, a shared Python-on-Q kernel plus a generated JavaScript twin, a cross-check runner producing Reproduction Cards, and a 21st MCP tool `toledo_eval`): of 841 entries eligible by status/format, 118 parse with real equation structure, and only 2 have an IR sidecar at all — both `status: candidate`, `reviewed_by: null`, 0 built. One of the two (`EQ-001/P.45.v1`) carries a disclosed sympy misparse (`Gamma_R` shattered into single-letter symbols, and the statement's second clause dropped entirely), caught by the pilot's own drift_note and blocked by its human-review gate; no corpus equation has been cross-checked end-to-end yet, and the site try-it widget renders on 0 pages by design. Reproduction evidence is otherwise unchanged from v1.6 (gauge-algebra dimension check PASS, Higgs-mass prediction FAIL against the published PDG value, IDM ladder-constants check PASS); R5 (independent reviewer) is still unheld for every entry. Ships a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server and command-line client (21 tools over stdio, a SQLite/FTS5 search index, and a static read API published on GitHub Pages) that lets an AI agent look an equation up before using it, plus a human-readable documentation site on the same GitHub Pages deployment. Each entry carries an honest coq_status (closed, definition, wrapped_related, mapped_not_wrapped, axioms, open_prop, or not_formalisable). Scope: equations and Th_coqc only; papers, books and prose live in their own records and cite Toledo codes.
